get.description: Owner token. Emits `hello` on connect, then `changed` whenever the daemon wrote state; both carry {"version":N}. Bursts are coalesced (≥150 ms apart). Clients re-read the resources they show; nothing is replayed after a reconnect. A `: ping` comment is sent every 15 s. At most 16 streams are open at once (429 too_many_streams).

post.description: Owner token. Answers 202 and stops shortly after: the API stops accepting requests, workers reach safe points and running jobs resume on the next start. Used by the tray's Quit.

501.description: This daemon cannot be stopped over HTTP

get.summary: Browse one folder of the owner's Drive
get.description: Owner only. Folders first, then by name; `path` is the breadcrumb from the highest visible ancestor (first page only). Read-only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Drive id, or `root` for My Drive

parameters.name: id

post.summary: Create a folder in the owner's Drive
post.description: Owner only. Idempotent: the write carries an intent derived from the key, the parent and the name, so a retry returns the same folder (`Idempotency-Replayed: true`). No sharing is changed.

BearerAuth.description: Opaque random token from protected client file; maps to principal server-side

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Principal/method/path scoped. Replay uses saved response; different payload returns 409.
